reference.criterion: Three-dimensional carbon-nanotube lattices are a prevalent computing-circuit technology.
reference.rationale: MIT’s 2019 carbon-nanotube processor was a research prototype, not the prevalent industrial circuit architecture. Carbon-nanotube research is not evidence of dominant production adoption. The forecast’s material choice was not realized by ordinary silicon scaling.
